sub_graphs.title: EIP-198: Modular Exponentiation Precompile Call Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of a call to the MODEXP precompile at address 0x05

nodes.label: MODEXP Call Received
nodes.description: System state when a CALL/STATICCALL/DELEGATECALL targets address 0x05 with input data

nodes.label: Parse Input Length Fields
nodes.description: Extract the three 32-byte length fields for BASE, EXPONENT, and MODULUS from call data

nodes.label: Input Lengths Parsed
nodes.description: System has parsed length_of_BASE, length_of_EXPONENT, length_of_MODULUS from input

nodes.label: Extract Operand Values
nodes.description: Extract BASE, EXPONENT, MODULUS from call data using parsed lengths, zero-padding if needed

nodes.label: Operands Extracted
nodes.description: All three operands (BASE, EXPONENT, MODULUS) are available for computation

nodes.label: Compute Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate required gas using mult_complexity and adjusted exponent length formula

nodes.label: Gas Cost Computed
nodes.description: Gas cost has been computed, ready for gas check

nodes.label: Check Gas Availability
nodes.description: Verify that available gas is sufficient for the computed cost

nodes.label: Gas Insufficient - OOG
nodes.description: Insufficient gas for operation, will throw out-of-gas exception

nodes.label: Gas Sufficient
nodes.description: Gas is sufficient, ready to perform modular exponentiation

nodes.label: Execute Modular Exponentiation
nodes.description: Compute (BASE ** EXPONENT) % MODULUS using arbitrary precision arithmetic

nodes.label: MODEXP Result Ready
nodes.description: Modular exponentiation complete, result ready to return

nodes.label: Format Output
nodes.description: Format result as byte array with length equal to MODULUS length

nodes.label: Precompile Call Succeeded
nodes.description: Call returns successfully with computed result

external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: Smart contract or EOA that invokes the MODEXP precompile via CALL opcode

sub_graphs.title: EIP-198: MODEXP Gas Pricing Model
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculation for modular exponentiation operations

nodes.label: Gas Calculation Initialized
nodes.description: System has operand lengths and is ready to compute gas cost

nodes.label: Compute Max Length
nodes.description: Calculate max(length_of_MODULUS, length_of_BASE) for complexity formula

nodes.label: Max Length Determined
nodes.description: Maximum of BASE and MODULUS lengths is known

nodes.label: Compute Multiplication Complexity
nodes.description: Apply mult_complexity formula based on max length (x^2, x^2/4+96x-3072, or x^2/16+480x-199680)

nodes.label: Multiplication Complexity Computed
nodes.description: mult_complexity value is computed based on operand sizes

nodes.label: Compute Adjusted Exponent Length
nodes.description: Calculate adjusted exponent length based on highest bit position and total length

nodes.label: Adjusted Exponent Length Known
nodes.description: Adjusted exponent length computed for gas formula

nodes.label: Compute Final Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate floor(mult_complexity * max(adjusted_exp_len, 1) / GQUADDIVISOR)

nodes.label: Final Gas Cost Determined
nodes.description: Total gas cost for MODEXP operation is determined

sub_graphs.title: EIP-198: Input Validation and Edge Cases
sub_graphs.description: Models validation rules and edge case handling for MODEXP inputs

nodes.label: Raw Input Received
nodes.description: Call data received, may be shorter or longer than expected

nodes.label: Check Input Data Length
nodes.description: Determine if input has enough bytes for length fields

nodes.label: Input Shorter Than Expected
nodes.description: Input data is shorter than declared lengths require

nodes.label: Apply Zero Padding
nodes.description: Treat missing bytes as zeros (infinite right-padding semantics)

nodes.label: Input Zero-Padded
nodes.description: Input effectively extended with zeros for missing data

nodes.label: Excess Input Data Present
nodes.description: Input has more bytes than needed

nodes.label: Ignore Excess Data
nodes.description: Discard any bytes beyond what lengths specify

nodes.label: Input Normalized
nodes.description: Input is properly sized for processing

nodes.label: Check if Modulus is Zero
nodes.description: Verify if modulus value is zero (special case)

nodes.label: Modulus is Zero
nodes.description: Modulus is zero, result should be zero

nodes.label: Modulus is Non-Zero
nodes.description: Modulus is valid for computation

ambiguities.text: The specification states call data is 'assumed to be infinitely right-padded with zero bytes' but does not specify behavior when all three lengths are declared as zero.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume when all lengths are zero, the operation returns an empty byte array with zero gas cost beyond base call cost.

ambiguities.text: The spec does not explicitly define the return value when MODULUS is zero.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume return value is a zero byte array of length equal to declared modulus length (all zeros).

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'highest bit' in exponent calculation is not precisely defined for the edge case where all bits are zero.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume highest bit index is 0 when the first 32 bytes of exponent are all zeros, and adjusted_exponent_length is zero.

implicit_assumptions.description: The underlying big integer arithmetic implementation correctly handles arbitrary precision without overflow or truncation errors.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect computation results could lead to RSA signature verification failures or accepting invalid cryptographic proofs.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Karatsuba multiplication approximation used in gas pricing accurately reflects real computational cost.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Gas mispricing could enable DoS attacks through underpriced expensive operations or make legitimate use economically unfeasible.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot craft inputs that cause the mult_complexity formula to significantly underestimate actual computation time.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Block gas limit exhaustion attacks possible through specially crafted MODEXP calls.
